description: Check whether an email address is well-formed and its domain can receive mail, before you send. Five DNS checks on an email address, no message sent: syntax, MX presence and hosts, SPF record, DMARC policy, disposable domain, role address. Returns deliverable as NO, RISKY or LIKELY. It does not open an SMTP session and says so: mailbox existence is explicitly not checked. Query: ?email= — $0.005000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "verify this email address", "is this email deliverable", "check this email".
name: email_verify
